# Files that neither CI nor a release uses: a pull request that only touches
# these skips CI (its jobs report as skipped, and the "CI" check passes).
# One bash `case` glob per line, matched against the path from the repo
# root (`*` also matches `/`). Lines starting with # and blank lines are
# ignored.
#
# Markdown files are not listed: CI lints them. LICENSE is not listed: the
# packages carry it.

.vscode/*
*.code-workspace
.editorconfig
.envrc
.gitignore
# the local checks script, which runs what CI runs
tools/agent/*
